jobs.occupation: Lead Strategy Consultant (Manager level), Strategy & Business Design
jobs.description:
Meet your team

[

Devoteam always offers you new opportunities to make you learn, expand your knowledge and evolve in your career path

Discover Layal’s story

](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OUqqJ_5rdl0&feature=youtu.be)

Job Description

Strategy & Digital Business Design is the Copenhagen strategy team inside Devoteam, a company of more than 11,000 tech professionals, around 350 of them here in Denmark.

Most companies by now have more AI ideas, pilots and PoCs than they know what to do with. We help them focus on the few problem spaces that matter, and we stay until the solutions create real value in the business.

We’re hiring one or more Lead Strategy Consultants. It’s a senior role. You run your own workstreams, you lead other consultants on them, and you’re comfortable in a room with the client’s leadership team without someone more senior next to you.

The work:

Most of our engagements start with a question like “where should we place our AI bets, and what are they worth?” From there, you’ll do AI strategy and readiness work with business leaders, shape the first use cases and pilot teams, and make sure the solutions make it past the PoC stage and into the business. Sometimes you’ll even build them yourself. We judge our work by the value it creates for the client. If a solution isn’t moving the numbers that matter, we challenge it and keep adjusting until it does, or we stop it. We expect everyone to go deep enough on the technology to test what models can and can’t do and hold their own with architects and engineers.

We work across industries, but we’re investing most in life sciences (pharma in particular) and manufacturing, where we are scaling our industry depth and experience.

What we’re looking for:

• 
Around 5 to 6 years in consulting, at a firm or in-house. Long enough to have structured problem solving in your bones, and to know when to ignore the frameworks or develop something new.

• 
You’ve run workstreams from scoping to delivery, with a team and a client, and you know how to manage upwards on both sides.

• 
You think in business value. You can put a number on what a solution is worth, and you keep pushing until it delivers.

• 
You’re the one who asks the awkward question in the steering committee, and you can back it up.

• 
You’re obsessively curious. You want to understand how things work, and you’ve usually gone down the rabbit hole before anyone asked you to.

• 
You use AI to work faster, but most importantly you still do the thinking yourself.

• 
Experience from life sciences or manufacturing is a clear plus.

• 
Fluent English. Danish is a bonus.

If you come from the build side:

We also want to hear from people who took a different route. If you’re an engineer or data scientist who ended up spending most of your time with the business, and you’ve built agents, data products or prototypes side by side with the people using them, please apply as well!

Why us?

• 
We’re on top of the newest AI tools, and they’re part of how we work and what we deliver. When something better comes out on a Tuesday, we’re using it by Thursday.

• 
Your ideas will be tested hard and either built or put down (nicely, of course).

• 
You’ll work with some of the largest companies in the Nordics on problems where AI changes the numbers.

• 
You’ll help shape our offerings and the methods behind them, especially in life sciences and manufacturing.

• 
You’re in charge of how you work. Work from home when it suits you. What we care about is that you grow and that our clients get results.

• 
We are a small team of ambitious people who like to spend time together both on and off work. We have various social events, we regularly have breakfast or dinner together and enjoy sharing knowledge on new AI tools, travel tips or anything else that we are passionate about.

How to apply:

Send your CV and half a page, or a two-minute video, answering two questions:

• 
Pick a company you know well. Where will AI change its economics most in the next three years, and what would you do first?

• 
What’s something technical you taught yourself, and why?

If you’re from the build side, send a link to something you’ve made and a few lines on what it taught you.

The interviews include a case. You’ll work through a client problem like the ones we see, and show us how you’d get from the question to something that works.

Skip the cover letter. Your answers tell us more.

Location: Hillerød, Denmark

Job category: Global Manufacturing & Supply

Department: Sustainability & Operational Excellence, Drug Delivery Innovation (DDI), Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS)

Your impact begins here

As Circularity Lead, you will make circular design part of everyday product development for the drug delivery de-vices and packaging that support people living with serious chronic diseases. You will turn circularity knowledge into practical guidance, influence development teams and keep products on track against our Circular for Zero strategy. Your work will shape how future products are designed, reduce their environmental footprint and help Global Manufacturing & Supply advance lasting health and a healthier planet together.

What you'll bring

• Practical experience applying sustainability and circularity to products

• Understanding of circular design principles and environmental knowledge you can apply in product development

• Hands-on experience in product design, product development or a closely related environment

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the confidence to reach out proactively across the organization

• The ability to influence development teams so sustainability requirements get the attention and resources they need

• Comfort working with data, including strong practical Excel skills

• A relevant academic background, such as Environmental Engineering, Engineering, Design & Innovation or sustainability-related studies. A relevant commercial background is also considered alongside strong professional experience

• Fluency in written and spoken English

Useful, but not essential:

• Direct circular design experience in a product setting

• Knowledge of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), including carbon footprint calculations and working with specialist LCA colleagues

• Experience with sustainable materials, plastics, recycling, non-fossil plastics or material innovation

• Experience from pharma, medical devices or a comparable product development environment

You are collaborative and proactive, structured and pragmatic, and curious about the latest trends in circularity. Deep expertise matters, but so does your ability to bring people with you.

What you'll do

You will connect circularity knowledge with product development, guiding teams and driving projects that move our sustainability goals forward.

• Ensure a state-of-the-art approach to circular design in drug delivery devices and packaging, tracking market trends and keeping the Circular Design Guideline up to date

• Provide scientific support on circularity, carbon footprint and plastic footprint, and guide project teams in interpreting circularity assessments

• Anchor Circular for Zero targets in DDI projects and drive circularity progress in key projects, including tools, assessments and process deliverables

• Act as Circular for Zero Process Manager, developing sustainability processes and building capabilities through training

• Drive key cross-organizational projects and share success stories that engage colleagues and stakeholders

Who you'll work with

You will join the Sustainability & Operational Excellence team within Drug Delivery Innovation (DDI), reporting to the Associate Director of Sustainability & Operational Excellence. The team drives and guides sustainability across all DDI areas through capability building, project support and clear communication, and is also responsible for integrating lean principles across DDI.

Your closest partners will be DDI project and programme managers, product developers, designers and engineers as well as commercial colleagues and environmental leads and experts in HQ.

Based in Hillerød, you will work with key stakeholders in Denmark across functions and organizational levels, creating clarity and momentum where circular design meets product development.

What you can expect here

You will work in a collaborative environment where your expertise shapes how future products are designed and made. You can broaden your perspective across the value chain, build new skills and take ownership of complex challenges that often have no precedent.

You will be trusted to make your voice heard and support to perform at your best, as part of a team that combines curiosity, collaboration and ambition to create meaningful progress.

What we offer

At Novo, you will join a global healthcare company with a distinctive culture and a strong track record. We offer continuous learning, career development and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 742,600 to DKK 1,091,600, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The compensation package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives, together with other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring circular design to life in the products that support people living with serious chronic diseases, apply for the Circularity Lead role by 19th November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Nanja Hedal Kløverpris, Assoc Director, Sustainability & Operational Excellence, at nnhk@novonordisk.com.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The OTC Supervisor leads the Order-to-Cash team and owns the quality, speed and control of our cash application, collections and reconciliation processes. The role has a special focus on reconciling card payments and delivery platform settlements across a high-volume, multi-location F&B business. You lead and develop the team, safeguard accurate month-end close deliverables, and drive standardisation and automation of OTC processes in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. The role reports to the Global OTC Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**_People and team leadership

_

• Lead, coach and develop the OTC team, plan workload and the close calendar, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery

_Reconciliation and cash application

_

• Own the daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation of card acquirer, payment provider and delivery platform settlements against POS data, bank and the general ledger

• Ensure differences, chargebacks, fees and missing settlements are resolved, including follow-up with external partners

• Ensure correct cash application, customer and franchise/B2B invoicing, collections and aged debt follow-up in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

_Close, control and reporting

_

• Ensure accurate balance sheet reconciliations, specifications and reporting for month-end, quarter-end and year-end close

• Support month-end close through AR and line of credit reconciliations and review of the allowance for doubtful accounts

• Safeguard internal controls and audit readiness, and report KPIs such as unmatched items and days to cash to management

_Process improvement and collaboration

_

• Drive standardisation, harmonisation and automation of OTC processes across markets

• Partner with Store Operations, Treasury, Accounting, IT and payment and delivery partners, and advise the business on OTC topics

• Act as a key member of cross-functional teams to improve the flow of data and reporting

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• You take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes

• You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift

• Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• +6 years in Order-to-Cash, accounts receivable or revenue accounting, incl. team lead experience

• Experience from retail, F&B, restaurant or hospitality with many locations

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

• Proven experience reconciling card payments (e.g. Adyen, Nets/Nexi, Worldline) and delivery platforms (e.g. Wolt, Uber Eats, Just Eat) to POS, bank and GL

• Strong accounting, process and Excel skills; degree in finance, accounting or business administration

• Fluent English (Danish is an advantage)

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Employment type: Full-Time

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer for advanced process solutions
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop technical process solutions for customers across the world and play a key role in transforming customer requirements into competitive and reliable industrial systems? Then this could be your next position.

On behalf of Simatek A/S, we are looking for a Process Engineer who will become a central technical resource in the company's Process & Proposal team and contribute to the continued development of customer-specific process solutions for industries worldwide.

About Simatek

Simatek A/S is an international engineering company specializing in air filtration, pneumatic conveying, dust handling, and process solutions for industries such as food, feed, grain, recycling, minerals, and industrial manufacturing. The company designs and delivers customized systems that help customers improve operational efficiency, product quality, environmental performance, and workplace safety. From its headquarters in Albertslund in Denmark, Simatek serves customers around the world and combines strong engineering expertise with a flexible and customer-oriented approach.

The position

As Process & Application Engineer, you will become part of Simatek's international Process & Proposal team with colleagues in both Denmark and India. Focusing primarily on solutions for the food, dairy, feed and grain industries, you will transform customer requirements into technically robust and commercially competitive process solutions.

Working closely with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will perform process calculations, size equipment, define system configurations and contribute to the development of tailored solutions that balance technical performance, cost efficiency and customer needs.

Your responsibilities will include

• Develop process solutions based on customer requirements and application data, identifying and solving technical issues in the process design

• Perform process calculations and system sizing for complete process installations

• Prepare and review process documentation

• Collaborate with suppliers regarding technical specifications and equipment selection

• Prepare technical proposals and quotations

• Contribute to the development and standardization of engineering tools, methods and solutions

• Work closely with R&D and the product management team to develop competitive solutions

• Support continuous improvement of process design standards and engineering practices

• Participate in occasional international travel for customer and technical meetings (approx. 20 days per year)

Your profile

We imagine you have a strong engineering background and experience developing process systems or technical solutions within industrial environments.

You likely bring:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree within Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline

• Experience within process engineering, system design or industrial solution development, with the ability to independently drive technical tasks

• Skilled in process calculations, equipment sizing and can read PFD and P&ID drawings

• Experience in preparing technical proposals, quotations or engineering project documentation is an advantage

• Experience from the food and dairy industry will be considered an advantage

• Professional proficiency in English. An additional language will be considered an advantage

As a person, you are analytical, solution-oriented and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You work in a structured manner, take ownership of your tasks and enjoy collaborating across technical and commercial disciplines.

Why join Simatek?

You will join an entrepreneurial organization where the distance from idea to implementation is short, allowing you to make a tangible impact.

The role offers:

• Flexible working conditions including the possibility of working from home, up to two days per week by agreement

• Attractive compensation package including pension scheme, health insurance and performance bonus

• An active social environment and employee association arranging events throughout the year

Interested?

Send your application and CV via the application button. We look forward to hearing from you.

For more information, you are very welcome to contact Senior Business Consultant Erik Bernskov at erik.bernskov@actief-hartmanns.dk or by phone at +45 41 21 13 29. All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

Actief Hartmanns manages the entire recruitment process on behalf of Simatek A/S, and all contact regarding the position should therefore be directed to us. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion or nationality.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been identified.

jobs.occupation: Design for Value & Cost Engineer – from concept to competitive edge, GN Hearing, Ballerup
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to apply your engineering, project leadership and sourcing expertise to the world of product development and manufacturing? Join us as Senior Project Manager in Design for Value (DfV) and impact the way we design, develop, and manufacture products at GN Hearing in Ballerup.

****The Team You Will Be Part Of

**Based at our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Design for Value team in Global Manufacturing & Operations, reporting directly to Director René Bergqvist.

In this role, you will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders worldwide, ensuring value and cost are managed effectively and optimized in our products from the early concept phase through to mass production.

**Your Contribution Is Appreciated And You Will

**

• Optimize products by supporting the organization with cost / value analysis in our products, modules, platforms and architecture

• Investigate and motivate for cost-effective design and manufacturability, e.g. via mapping of value / cost opportunities related to roadmap, product, and design options

• Manage cost targets and running estimate for ramp up in development projects

• Facilitate and support project sourcing activities including availability reviews, supplier selection, RFQs, and negotiations

• Support building positive business cases together with R&D & Product Marketing

• Facilitate and conduct project reviews related to Design for Value, Cost and Manufacturing

• Follow up and guard the cost in product development by working with R&D on their suggested specification, manufacturing or material selection

You will also work on introducing new technologies and innovations during product development and play a key role in approving targets and results before critical milestones are passed.

You will also support key cross-functional projects that are part of strategic initiatives (“must-win battles”) with significant value or savings impact from an Operations and Sourcing perspective.

**Role

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you - besides having a technical mindset and a good business understanding - have:

• A degree or similar within engineering, preferably within electronics

• Experience within platform and product development, supplier sourcing or cost/value optimization in a R&D environment are positive differentiators

• Good at solving both technical and commercial issues

• General understanding of manufacturing processes and industrialization

• Experience with LEAN, Design for Value/Cost, or supplier sourcing in Asia, are positive differentiators

• Presentation, negotiation, and communication skills in English, both written and spoken

In addition, you have an engaging personality and possess facilitation skills, enabling you to build networks and engage stakeholders. You also possess solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, which you use to identify issues and propose effective solutions.

You are, furthermore, steadfast and enjoy working in a multicultural, changing environment. You take initiative and, most importantly, follow through on the initiatives you start.

**We Offer

**

• A unique opportunity to grow and gain experience across both engineering and business

• A supportive and dynamic work environment where you can learn to navigate change with confidence

• Opportunities for professional and personal growth in a top-tier global high-tech company.

• The chance to contribute meaningfully to GN

• An international and collaborative workplace

**We encourage you to apply

**We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that align with our core values, to not only ensure your growth, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the Interview please let the hiring manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 25 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our leading intelligent hearing, inspired by people and driven by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss overcome real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

**_Do you want to immerse yourself in testing and quality assurance of large and complex software projects that help digitalise and strengthen Denmark? Are you systematic, with a keen eye for detail? Then you might be the person we are looking for as our new Test Consultant.

_**Responsibilities And Technologies

**Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

You will always be part of a project team from Netcompany, typically working together on-site with the client. In this role, you will act as the link between the client, their business needs, and our technical solution.

You will continuously develop your testing and technical skills. Throughout your projects, you will gain hands-on experience with a wide range of the latest technologies and tools.

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Ensuring the quality of the solution through various types of testing

• Analysing the functional aspects of the solution

• Preparing test plans and designing and writing test cases

• Executing functional and non-functional tests

• Contributing to troubleshooting and test reporting

**About You

**You can work methodically and connect business and IT-related challenges, explaining business needs to developers and technical aspects to clients. In addition, we imagine that you:

• Can navigate complex error scenarios and understand complex system landscapes

• Are systematic and detail-oriented throughout the analysis, design, development, and testing phases

• Think logically and analytically, and can break down and understand complex concepts and communicate issues and gaps clearly and effectively

• Hold a relevant master’s degree

Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

**Join an inclusive community

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

Job title: Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology, you will help build a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research that generates and validates therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. You will combine hands-on rodent pharmacology with original scientific thinking, shaping research questions and turning emerging biology into opportunities for drug discovery. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in pharmacology, physiology, neuroscience or a related discipline, or bring equivalent relevant research experience. You also bring:

• At least two years of relevant post-PhD experience with scientific innovation, or equivalent scientific contributions.

• Hands-on experience in rodent pharmacology.

• Strong skills in experimental design, quantitative analysis and interpretation of complex biological data.

• Scientific depth in metabolic physiology, neuroscience, in vitro pharmacology, or a related area.

• Original scientific thinking, intellectual curiosity and the ability to turn ideas into testable hypotheses.

• A collaborative approach and the ability to work independently while contributing to shared research goals.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience in metabolic phenotyping, advanced behavioural assays, rodent surgery, modern neuroscience methods, in vitro or ex vivo approaches, or developing novel experimental technologies. We welcome complementary profiles – you are not expected to bring expertise in every method or scientific area.

**What You Will Do

**You will contribute to both the scientific direction and hands-on experimental work of the team. Your responsibilities will include:

• Generate hypotheses and propose new therapeutic concepts grounded in biological understanding.

• Design, conduct, analyse and interpret mouse and rat pharmacology studies to investigate efficacy, mechanism of action and physiological responses.

• Develop experimental models and introduce methodologies that enable us to address challenging scientific questions.

• Connect in vivo findings with relevant in vitro and ex vivo experiments.

• Integrate evidence into recommendations on how emerging concepts should advance, change direction or be discontinued.

• Document and communicate findings, sharing scientific insights across disciplines and project teams.

• Contribute to rigorous, reproducible experimental practice and high standards of animal welfare.

All scientists are expected to contribute directly to experimental work alongside laboratory technicians and fellow scientists.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to shape the research of a new team and contribute your own ideas, in an environment that values thoughtful scientific challenge, collaboration and learning from unexpected findings.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasks
We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Cyber security
• Privacy engineering
• Computer Systems
• Edge/cloud computing
• High-Performance Computing (HPC)
• Data Engineering
• Big Data Infrastructure
• Machine Learning Systems
The main tasks and responsibilities include:

• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
• participating in grant application activities
• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment
Your competencies
You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we are
In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-track
When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
• The candidate is a skilled communicator
• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process
Evaluation and promotion proces:

• Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
• A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
• A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
• Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship 
Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship
The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 
If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
• References/recommendations 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Chief Commercial Officer (CCO)

Location: On site (Denmark, near Værløse, 20 min NW of central Copenhagen)

Reporting to: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Shape the Commercial Future of a High-Tech Drone Defense Company

UMag Solutions is a rapidly growing defence technology company developing and manufacturing advanced Quantum Magnetic Sensing payloads for Autonomous Systems for military, government, and allied customers around the world. Our solutions are used for land- and naval min detection as well as anti-submarine warfare.

Today, we are a team of approximately 45 highly skilled professionals. Over the next three years, we expect to triple our organization and establish subsidiaries in key international markets. We are therefore seeking a visionary Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) to join our Executive Management Team.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the company while building and scaling-up a world-class commercial organization that supports our continued international expansion.

You will lead the Commercial Organization through four experienced functional leaders:

• Sales

• Marketing

• Technical Solutions, Support & Partnerships

• Operations & Logistics

As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will work closely with the CEO and fellow executives to shape company strategy, drive growth, and ensure the organization is prepared for its next stage of development.

• Create alignment across all customer-facing functions.

• Establish a culture focused on customer success and sustainable growth.

• Build the commercial organization required to support international expansion.

• Develop strategic customer relationships.

• Lead commercial planning and sales forecasting.

• Strengthen opportunity management and pipeline quality.

• Support major negotiations and strategic customer engagements.

• Improve commercial processes and performance.

• Develop marketing strategies supporting business growth.

• Build brand awareness within the global defense sector.

• Oversee product positioning, communications, digital marketing, and industry events.

• Support all commercial functions (sales, marketing, operations, support) with relevant advanced technical information when needed

• Improve customer satisfaction and retention.

• Establish scalable customer support processes

• Ensure world-class after-sales support.

• Develop service offerings supporting recurring business.

Operations & Logistics

• Make sure that our operation team members and other employees are up-to-speed on products before going on product demonstrations or tradeshows

• Oversee commercial logistics related to demonstrations and customer deliveries.

• Ensure timely and compliant international shipment of products.

• Continuously improve customer-facing operational processes.

• Coordinate testing of prototype hardware and software solutions before stable releases

Strategic Responsibilities

As the company scales, you will play a key role in building the commercial organization of the future.

This includes:

• Designing scalable commercial structures and governance.

• Developing commercial KPIs and performance management.

• Building leadership capabilities throughout the commercial organization.

• Supporting the establishment of international subsidiaries.

• Standardizing commercial processes across multiple locations.

• Driving cross-functional collaboration between Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, Engineering, Production, Finance, and Product Management.

• Supporting strategic partnerships, international market expansion, and long-term growth initiatives.

You are an experienced and fast-moving commercial executive who combines strategic thinking with operational excellence.

You are not afraid of using and implementing AI wherever it makes sense in the commercial organization.

You have successfully built and led commercial organizations during periods of rapid growth and understand how to create structure without losing agility.

You thrive in environments where you can influence strategy while remaining close to execution.

Most importantly, you enjoy developing people, building strong leadership teams, and creating organizations capable of sustained international growth.

Qualifications

• A university degree in Business, Engineering, Military Studies, or a related field.

• Significant senior commercial leadership experience, preferably as a Chief Commercial Officer, Senior Business Developer, Commercial Director, VP Commercial, or similar executive role.

• Experience from a high-tech product company, preferably within defense, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing.

• Demonstrated success scaling commercial organizations in a growing company.

• Experience leading leaders and developing management teams.

• Strong understanding of complex B2G and B2B sales environments.

• Experience with international customers and government procurement processes.

• Strong commercial, financial, and strategic business acumen.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

International travel should be expected to partner companies, product demonstrations and tradeshows.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first years, you will have:

• Strengthened collaboration across all customer-facing functions.

• Positioned the company as a preferred partner within the international defense and drone industry.

• Built an integrated, high-performing commercial organization.

• Implemented AI in all relevant processes

• Improved commercial forecasting and governance.

• Increased customer satisfaction.

• Established scalable commercial processes capable of supporting continued growth beyond 100 employees.

• Supported successful international expansion.

Why Join Us?

This is more than a traditional commercial leadership role.

We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

jobs.description:
Do you want to lead infrastructure projects that power and protect Europe’s future? Do you have the experience, leadership skills and commercial mindset needed to deliver some of Europe’s most strategic energy infrastructure projects? And can you lead multidisciplinary teams? Then, come join COWI!  **Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**At COWI, we help our clients address some of society’s most important challenges.

The energy landscape is changing rapidly. Europe is investing in resilient energy infrastructure, decarbonisation, critical infrastructure and strategic energy systems that strengthen security of supply and societal resilience.

To support this development, we are looking for an experienced Project Director to join our Green Energy infrastructure team in Lyngby.

You will become part of our engineering environment working with:

• Hydrogen infrastructure

• CO₂ transportation and storage

• Gas transmission systems

• LNG and ammonia terminals

• Energy storage facilities

• Critical infrastructure

• Defence-related energy infrastructure

• NATO Pipeline System (NPS) developments

• Energy Security & Resilience

You should bring a strong technical foundation and solid experience within one or more of the above, however we are not looking for an expert in all the areas. But we need you to understand complex engineering challenges and provide qualified technical sparring across multidisciplinary teams.

**Drive projects from strategy to implementation

**A significant part of our project portfolio originates in the early project phases, where clients define future investments and establish the technical and commercial foundations for large infrastructure projects.

As Project Director, you will play a key role in guiding clients through feasibility assessments, concept development, Pre-FEED and FEED phases, before supporting implementation through detailed design and Owner’s Engineer assignments.

You will be responsible for leading multidisciplinary teams across Denmark and our international delivery centres while ensuring technical quality, commercial performance and strong client relationships.

Your key responsibilities

• Lead large and complex multidisciplinary energy infrastructure projects.

• Act as Project Director on feasibility studies, Pre-FEED, FEED, detailed design and Owner’s Engineer assignments.

• Support clients in defining and developing future energy infrastructure investments.

• Develop trusted long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders.

• Drive commercial performance, governance and project risk management.

• Lead international and multidisciplinary project teams.

• Support business development and major proposal activities.

• Mentor and develop project managers and technical specialists.

• Contribute to COWI’s growth within Energy Security, Resilience and Critical Infrastructure.

• Support emerging opportunities within defence-related energy infrastructure and NATO Pipeline System projects.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.**We are looking for a highly experienced project leader who combines solid technical understanding with strong project execution capabilities.

On top of that, you will have:

• 15+ years of experience from multidisciplinary engineering and project management.

• A strong technical background and in-depth experience within one or more areas such as pipelines systems, terminals, process facilities or other energy infrastructure.

• The technical understanding needed to engage with specialists, challenge technical solutions and lead multidisciplinary engineering teams.

• Experience from feasibility studies, Pre-FEED, FEED, detailed design and/or Owner’s Engineer assignments.

• Strong commercial understanding and contract management experience.

• Experience managing large projects and multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

• Experience working in international project environments.

• A relevant engineering degree.

We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Peter Malmkjær, Head of Projects, Green Energy Pipelines at PRMR@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**About The Role

**At FLS, we have simplified our business and strengthened our profitability in recent years. We are now shifting our focus to accelerating profitable growth. To steer this journey, we are establishing a Corporate Growth Office that leads our strategic growth and profitability initiatives in close cooperation with our Business Lines, Group Functions and other stakeholders.

As Director, Corporate Growth Office and Strategy, you will build and run the engine that turns our strategic ambitions into owned, tracked and delivered results. You will own the portfolio management, governance and operating rhythm of the Corporate Growth Office. This spans the monthly Growth Office reviews in our Executive Leadership Team and in each Business Line performance review. You will also connect the initiative portfolio to our corporate strategy process. As deputy to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will be a trusted sparring partner to Business Line Presidents, Finance and initiative owners.

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will join a small, high-calibre team at our headquarters in Copenhagen. Around 80% of the role is dedicated to running the Corporate Growth Office and around 20% to corporate strategy work. The Growth Office enables, challenges and connects: our Business Lines own the delivery of their initiatives, and you will make sure it happens with pace, rigour and transparency.

**What You Gain

**This is a rare opportunity to build a Growth Office from the ground up at a pivotal moment for FLS, and to shape how a global industrial company steers its growth. You will gain:

• Close collaboration with our CEO, the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line Presidents and Business Line management teams.

• An enterprise-wide view of how FLS creates value across Business Lines, Group Functions, sales areas and our mergers and acquisitions (M&A) agenda.

• Visible impact, as your work shows directly in our results and in how we work together as one FLS.

• A broad platform for your professional development, combining growth office leadership with corporate strategy.

• The chance to help the mining industry move towards a more sustainable future.

**You will play a key role in

**_Setting up and running the Corporate Growth Office

_

• Designing and embedding the Growth Office operating model with the Head of Corporate Growth Office, including governance forums, roles and decision rights, the stage-gate process, value rules and reporting standards.

• Turning our corporate management model into a working operating rhythm, including the monthly Growth Office review in the Executive Leadership Team and the Growth Office segment of each monthly Business Line performance review.

• Building an in-house playbook and capability, so that FLS eventually runs its growth agenda with its own people, tools and routines.

_Managing the growth portfolio

_

• Owning one Group-wide view of growth workstreams and initiatives, with clear owners, milestones, value targets, risks and interdependencies.

• Running the stage-gate process from idea to realised value, including gate-readiness checks and rigour tests before key decisions.

• Keeping the pipeline healthy through quarterly re-prioritisation and backfilling of initiatives, and spotting off-track initiatives early.

_Executive governance and reporting

_

• Preparing decision-ready material for the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line leadership on value delivered against plan, value at risk, stage-gate decisions and blockers.

• Maintaining decision and action logs, driving follow-up and escalating issues that need executive attention.

• Contributing to Executive Leadership Team and Board updates and to the messages cascaded to the wider organisation.

• Deputising for the Head of Corporate Growth Office in executive forums.

_Value tracking with Finance

_

• Defining the baselines, impact categories and validation rules that make reported value credible, together with Group and Business Line Finance.

• Reconciling initiative value with forecasts, budgets and actual results every month.

• Rolling out and governing a common initiative-tracking software platform as the single source of truth.

_Partnering with Business Lines and Group Functions

_

• Acting as the Growth Office’s lead partner for selected Business Lines and Functions and challenging the ambition, pace and quality of their plans.

• Helping each Business Line establish its own Growth Office cadence in line with our common practice.

• Coordinating cross-Business Line and cross-functional initiatives, and supporting the integration of acquisitions into the growth portfolio.

_Corporate strategy

_

• Supporting the annual strategy process and preparing strategy material for the Executive Leadership Team and the Board.

• Translating strategic and financial targets into Business Line growth ambitions, key performance indicators (KPIs) and initiative portfolios.

• Leading selected strategic analyses, such as market and competitor insights, growth levers and business cases.

_Building capability and a performance culture

_

• Training initiative owners and Business Line Growth Office leads in our ways of working, methods and tools.

• Working with Communications and People & Culture on the growth narrative, success stories and recognition.

• Promoting transparency, accountability and fact-based decision-making across the organisation.

**To succeed in the role, you

**_Experience and education

_

• Have at least eight years of professional experience, including several years with a leading management consultancy, or equivalent.

• Have hands-on experience of setting up and running a transformation, growth or program management office end to end, ideally in a growth or commercial transformation and not only in a cost program.

• Have led or steered large, cross-functional initiative portfolios with direct exposure to CEOs, executive teams and boards.

• Bring experience of strategy work, such as translating strategic targets into initiatives and KPIs; experience of running a corporate strategy process or M&A integration is an advantage.

• Ideally bring experience from industrial, capital goods, mining, energy or other business-to-business companies with a strong service business.

• Hold a master’s degree in business, economics, engineering or a related field; an MBA is an advantage.

_Knowledge and skills

_

• Know the mechanics of a well-run growth office: stage gates, value tracking and validation, governance cadence, performance dialogues and tracking tools.

• Have strong financial acumen, including profit and loss logic, business cases, baselines and impact validation, and work naturally with Finance.

• Understand commercial growth levers such as pricing, sales effectiveness, aftermarket and service growth, and product and portfolio management.

• Create clear, concise and decision-ready material and storylines in PowerPoint and Excel; experience with strategic program management tools is an advantage.

• Are fluent in English; other languages are an advantage.

_Personal qualities

_

• Have the executive presence and credibility to challenge senior leaders constructively and to influence without formal authority.

• Are highly structured, rigorous and detail-oriented, while staying pragmatic and focused on what moves the needle.

• Stay resilient and composed under pressure and in ambiguity.

• Are collaborative and inclusive, with a coaching mindset and a ‘one FLS’ attitude.

• Act with integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.

• Are based in, or willing to relocate to, Copenhagen, and are able to travel when needed.

• Have a genuine interest in FLS, our customers, the mining industry and our MissionZero ambition.

Total salary range incl. variable pay: DKK 1,220,000–1,800,000 per year.

• The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

For more information about the role, please contact Anssi Poutanen, Head of Corporate Growth Office, at Anssi.Poutanen@FLSmidth.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.
